description: Alpha's key list for the offline release key ceremony (`pnpm aosp keys generate`, which reads it unless given another): the APK and module certificates, APEX container and payload keys, the OTA package key releasekey and the AVB key the Pixel 10a image signing uses, plus the one Alpha application key. Names and parameters only, never key material. The ceremony's public fingerprints are recorded in apps/app/aosp/signing/public, the release descriptor (aosp/pixel10a-release.json) and the update channel (aosp/pixel10a-ota-channel.json).

keys.name: releasekey
keys.consumer: APKs signed with testkey/releasekey; OTA package signature and otacerts.zip

keys.name: apex
keys.consumer: APEX container signature for all APEXes

keys.name: avb
keys.consumer: vbmeta and chained partitions; avb_pkmd.bin for avb_custom_key or factory fusing; release contract avb.publicKeySha256

keys.name: alphaphone_app
keys.consumer: Alpha Phone launcher release and Sense listener APKs share this one certificate; android/release-signer.json signerSha256
keys.rotatable: only through an APK signature scheme v3 rotation lineage
